title: Gusinzira birenze igihe
intro: Ibaze igihe ukuri kwacerezwa, abemera bagahigwa. Umugwi mutoyi wahisemwo gusubira inyuma aho kwitanga, uronka ubuhungiro mu bibanza bidashoboka cane — ahantu hobaye ahantu ho kuruhukira mu binjana n’ibindi bitagira uko bingana. Igihe amaherezo bavyuka, isi yari yarahindutse ibakikuje. None abo bantu bariko barasinzira ni bande?
clues: Twari abakiri bato tuba mu gisagara ca kera.
Abanyagihugu twabamwo barasaba ko dusenga iruhande yabo, ariko twaranka.
Twarahunze ico gisagara turondera ubuhungiro ku barwanya ivyo twemera.
Umugenzi w’intahemuka w’amaguru ane yaragumye ku bwinjiriro bw’aho twari twihishije.
Allah yatumye turyama imyaka amajana atatu n’icenda.
Igihe amaherezo twavyuka, igisagara cacu cahora kidutoteza cari carakiriye ukwizera.

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
